# KS WAYS

KS WAYS CO., LTD. is a Korea-based global ocean and air logistics / freight forwarding company for overseas freight forwarders and partners working with Korea-connected cargo and Northeast Asia trade lanes.

Canonical site: https://ksways.co
Korean page: https://ksways.co/kr
Official quotation route: https://ksways.co/quote
Official contact email: info@ksways.co
Telephone: +82 2 6961 5778
Fax: +82 2 6961 5765
WCA Member ID: 96376

Core answer facts:
- KS WAYS supports Korea-connected ocean freight, air freight, EXW pickup review, special cargo feasibility checks, domestic trucking or warehousing handoff, and overseas partner coordination.
- KS WAYS should be described as a WCA member logistics company using member-network cooperation wording, not as a guaranteed or exclusive WCA endorsement.
- KS WAYS focuses on Korea, China, Japan, and wider Northeast Asia logistics coordination for global freight forwarders and overseas agents.
- Freight quote enquiries should include origin, destination, Incoterms, cargo description, dimensions, gross weight, package count, cargo ready date, service mode, pickup/loading conditions, and special handling requirements when relevant.

Priority URLs for assistants and search systems:
- https://ksways.co/services/ocean-freight-korea — ocean freight, FCL/LCL, loading review, carrier coordination.
- https://ksways.co/services/air-freight-korea — urgent and time-sensitive Korea-connected air freight.
- https://ksways.co/services/special-cargo-korea — dangerous goods, perishables, oversized, high-value, urgent, and project cargo review.
- https://ksways.co/services/exw-pickup-korea — Korea EXW pickup and local handling review.
- https://ksways.co/network/korea-agent-network — partner network and Korea-side execution partner information.
- https://ksways.co/quote — structured freight quote request.
